mmvp.protocol: one seeded image from each complementary MMVP pair; 75 A and 75 B answers; exact-option constrained output

metric_protocol.faithfulness: Insertion/deletion AUC; patch methods change 8 merged patches per step and dense methods use 64 equal-fraction steps
metric_protocol.coco_pointing_game: shared/eval_point_game_coco.py with pg_criterion=centroid; patch_mode=centroid for patch methods

qwen.coco.ours.notes: Current retained method and old yes/no object prompt.

qwen.coco.eagle.notes: Pointing Game excludes the three audited exception cases, hence n=247.

qwen.mmvp.ours.notes: Forced-choice MMVP-150 adapter is ready; this protocol needs a fresh run.

qwen.mmvp.input_level.notes: The input-level code currently implements the COCO yes/no protocol only.

qwen.mmvp.eagle.notes: The repository contains a legacy free-form MMVP-300 EAGLE runner, not a forced-choice MMVP-150 adapter.

qwen.mmvp.tam.notes: No forced-choice MMVP-150 TAM adapter exists yet.

qwen.mmvp.llavacam.notes: No forced-choice MMVP-150 LLaVA-CAM adapter exists yet.
